title: Boolean Variables

lines.explanation: Include the library for working with streaming data to and from the user
Add a reference to standard namespace that includes variables, types, constants, and functions
Open the body of the function
Declare a Boolean variable (can take values true or false)
Assign the Boolean variable the initial value of "true"
Display the value of the variable on the screen and end with a line break
Change the value of the Boolean variable to false
display the new value of the variable and end with the line break (switch to the next line)
main() is a function, so it should return a value. We make it 0, or in this case a dummy value
